verses.17:63: قَالَ ٱذۡهَبۡ فَمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ فَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَآؤُكُمۡ جَزَآءࣰ مَّوۡفُورࣰ ا

meaning: The root "wfr" means to be or make full, complete, abundant, or ample. It applies to things like property, herbage, and even one's honor or dignity.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
